TL;DR I loved 2025's Superman and here's why. SPONSORED BY PROTON VPN: https://protonvpn.com/princessweekes
🫶🏾 General Disclaimer: This video only covers a narrow part of this topic and not an exhaustive look into the topic. Anything left out was either cut for brevity/subject matter or simply did not come up in my research. I encourage anyone to fill in any gaps I may have missed with their own content or in the comments. 🫶🏾
Superman 2025 strove to combat the idea that Superman sees himself as a God or that he is somehow “above” humanity. This has led to a lot of people revisiting 2013’s Man of Steel by Zack Snyder, but I would say that the root of Superman cynicism in the film world goes back to 2004.
